# Lightbridge-KS

### 👨🏻 About Me

Hello there! I’m a diagnostic radiologist and software developer building practical tools at the intersection of radiology, medical AI, data science, and developer experience.

You are welcome to visit: [**🌱 My Website**](https://lightbridge.netlify.app) and [**🍑 My Blog**](https://lightbridge-blog.netlify.app).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Projects

#### Agent Tools

- 🧩 **[openclaw-notebook-tools](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/openclaw-notebook-tools)** - Jupyter Notebook plugin tools for OpenClaw agents: create, read, list, search, edit, and delete cells (Experimental).

#### Radiology Tools

**Apps**

- 🩻 **[designcter](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/designcter)** - CT protocol design and radiology calculator app.
- 🧾 **[radflow](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/radflow)** - CT/MRI protocol template generation and radiology calculator app.
- 🦋 **[tirads-calc-py](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/tirads-calc-py)** - ACR TI-RADS calculator built with Python and Shiny.

**CLI**

- 🧰 **[slicer-cli](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/slicer-cli)** - Unofficial Python CLI for interacting with 3D Slicer Web Server.

#### Libraries & Packages

- 🇹🇭 **[thaipdf](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/thaipdf)** - R Markdown and PDF tooling for Thai-language documents.
- 🔎 **[radreportparser](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/radreportparser)** - Regex-based parser for common radiology report text.
- 📁 **[pyrfs](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/pyrfs)** - Pythonic filesystem ergonomics inspired by R's fs

#### Notes & Books

- 🏗️ **[software-design-explore](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/software-design-explore)** - Exploratory notes and book on software design.
- 🍳 **[design-patterns-cookbook](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/design-patterns-cookbook)** - Cookbook-style design pattern reference.
- 📊 **[radio-ds-notes](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/radio-ds-notes)** - Radiology data science notes.
- 🔥 **[py-dl](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/py-dl)** - Deep learning with Python notes.
- 📐 **[ss4medr](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS/ss4medr)** - Sample size calculation guide for medical research with R.
